status.en: 20 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 36% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 20 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 36 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Israeli forces carried out an overnight raid in the Daraa buffer zone, killing a Syrian man with Down syndrome, while Syrian security officers were killed in a separate raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus. Syrian internal security also launched a counter-terror operation against an ISIS cell in Rankous, resulting in the deaths of two security personnel and clashes with suspected ISIS fighters in the Damascus countryside. These incidents show simultaneous Israeli cross-border strikes and Syrian government actions against ISIS remnants. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker gjennomførte et overnattingsraids i Daraa-buffersonen, og drepte en syrisk mann med Downs syndrom, mens syriske sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept i et separat raid på en IS-celle nær Damaskus. Syrisk intern sikkerhet igangsatte også en antiterroroperasjon mot en IS-celle i Rankous, som førte til døden til to sikkerhetspersonell og sammenstøt med mistenkte IS-kjempere på landsbygda utenfor Damaskus. Disse hendelsene viser samtidige israelske grenseangrep og syriske regjeringsaksjoner mot IS-rester. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
